title: abelmoschus moschatus subsp. biakensis
intro: Abelmoschus moschatus subsp. biakensis, commonly known as Hibiscus abelmoschus, is a plant species within the Malvaceae family, native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Hibiscus abelmoschus include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and acting as an antiseptic to prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
